title: HR Manager
description:
**1. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for engineering, technical, manufacturing, sales, and corporate positions.
* Hire Mechanical Design Engineers, Electrical Engineers, PLC/SCADA Engineers, Automation Engineers, Project Engineers, Production Engineers, and other technical professionals.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements and prepare recruitment plans.
* Develop effective sourcing strategies, maintain talent pipelines, and reduce time-to-hire.
* Manage recruitment agencies, job portals, interviews, offer negotiations, and onboarding.

**2. HR Operations & Administration**

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle, including joining, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and separation.
* Maintain employee records, HR databases, attendance, leave management, and personnel documentation.
* Develop and implement HR policies, procedures, and employee handbooks.
* Oversee HR administration and coordinate with the administration team for smooth operations.

**3. Payroll & Statutory Compliance**

* Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary revisions, incentives, deductions, and full-and-final settlements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, including EPF, ESIC, professional tax, gratuity, bonus, and other applicable regulations.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, and compliance records.
* Coordinate with finance, payroll vendors, auditors, and government authorities as required.

**4. Employee Relations & Engagement**

* Build positive employee relations and address grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace concerns.
* Develop employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, and retention strategies.
* Handle employee communication and support a professional, respectful workplace culture.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyze attrition trends.

**5. Performance Management & Development**

* Implement performance appraisal systems, KPIs, KRAs, and employee development plans.
* Coordinate annual appraisals, increments, promotions, and performance improvement plans.
* Identify training needs for technical, managerial, and shop-floor employees.
* Support succession planning and leadership development.

**6. Industrial Relations & Shop-Floor HR**

* Manage workforce-related matters for production, assembly, fabrication, installation, and service teams.
* Address shop-floor discipline, absenteeism, overtime, shift management, and workforce productivity.
* Support contract labour management and contractor compliance, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with operations and production teams to resolve manpower-related issues.

**7. POSH & Workplace Compliance**

* Implement and communicate workplace policies, including POSH and the Code of Conduct.
* Facilitate POSH awareness training and support the Internal Committee in fulfilling its responsibilities.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure appropriate handling of workplace complaints.
* Promote diversity, inclusion, employee well-being, and a safe working environment.

**8. HR Strategy & Management Reporting**

* Develop HR budgets, manpower plans, retention strategies, and organizational development initiatives.
* Prepare monthly HR MIS reports covering headcount, recruitment, attrition, absenteeism, payroll, and training.
* Monitor HR metrics and recommend improvements in employee productivity and cost efficiency.
* Partner with senior management to support business expansion and organizational effectiveness.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of HR operations and end-to-end recruitment.
* Experience in engineering, manufacturing, industrial automation, or machinery companies.
* Knowledge of labour laws, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, and employee relations.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work with cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, payroll systems, and recruitment portals.

Preferred Industry Experience

Industrial Automation, Robotics, PLC/SCADA, Control Panels, Machine Manufacturing, Special Purpose Machines (SPM), CNC Machinery, Fabrication, Electrical Engineering, and Industrial Equipment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely fulfilment of manpower requirements.
* Reduction in recruitment turnaround time and employee attrition.
* Payroll accuracy and statutory compliance.
* Employee engagement and retention.
* Training effectiveness and performance appraisal completion.
* HR cost optimization and workforce productivity.

**Application Process:** Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and current location.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹850,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Head - Technology & AI | E-Commerce | AI Agents | Engineering & Automations
description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.

We have made a clear strategic choice: **Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.**

We are looking for a **hands-on Technology & AI leader** who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems — quickly.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role.

You will own the intersection of **business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security**. You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.

Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.

We need someone who enjoys that challenge.

**What You Will Own**
=====================

**1. Technology Execution & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.

You will:

* Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
* Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
* Track commitments through completion — not merely development activity.
* Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
* Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
* Build clear visibility from:

**Business Requirement**  **Development**  **Production**  **Adoption**  **Business Impact**

* Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
* Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.

### **Success means:**

Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, **“Where is this project stuck and who owns it?”**

**2. Business-First Technology Strategy**
=========================================

Technology exists to improve business outcomes.

You will:

* Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.
* Understand marketplace fees, margins, inventory, pricing, advertising, catalogue operations, fulfilment and customer experience.
* Own the Technology & AI roadmap based on impact on:
  + Revenue
  + Gross margin
  + Productivity
  + Operating cost
  + Speed
  + Customer/vendor experience
* Work directly with business heads to identify operational bottlenecks.
* Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
* Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
* Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
* Report technology performance to leadership in **business outcomes rather than project activity**.

**3. AI, Agents & Intelligent Automation**
==========================================

AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.

You will:

* Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
* Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into **real production environments**.
* Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
* Integrate AI into areas including:
  + Catalogue and content
  + Marketplace listings
  + Pricing
  + Inventory
  + Customer support
  + Sales
  + Finance
  + HR
  + Reporting and decision support
* Build with LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks and workflow automation.
* Establish before/after baselines for every major automation.
* Measure:
  + hours/FTE capacity saved
  + cycle-time reduction
  + cost reduction
  + quality improvement
  + revenue/margin impact
  + user adoption
* Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
* Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.

### **We are not looking for:**

Someone who has attended AI courses or built demos.

### **We are looking for:**

Someone who has **put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.**

**4. E-commerce Platforms & Marketplace Technology**
====================================================

Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.

You will own and strengthen:

* Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
* Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
* Pricing and quantity synchronization.
* Order processing.
* Inventory and warehouse integrations.
* Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
* Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
* API reliability and monitoring.

You will build toward a connected architecture where catalogue, inventory, order and marketplace information flows reliably across systems.

The goal is not simply integration.

The goal is **reliable commerce at scale**.

**5. Product & Platform Ownership**
===================================

You will take ownership of Ergode’s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.

This includes:

* evaluating existing architecture,
* identifying technical debt,
* establishing clear module ownership,
* improving reliability and usability,
* prioritising development based on business value,
* and driving adoption after launch.

Technology is not complete when code is deployed.

**A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.**

**6. Data Foundation & Decision Intelligence**
==============================================

AI is only as strong as the underlying data.

You will:

* Build reliable data flows across business systems.
* Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
* Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
* Improve data quality and ownership.
* Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
* Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.

**7. Architecture, Cloud & Engineering Quality**
================================================

You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.

You will:

* Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
* Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
* Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
* Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
* Prototype when speed requires it.
* Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.

We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a **CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.**

**8. Security, Reliability & AI Governance**
============================================

You will own the reliability and security of Ergode’s technology environment.

Responsibilities include:

* Cloud and infrastructure reliability
* Monitoring and uptime
* Incident management
* Root-cause analysis
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Identity and access management
* SSO
* Endpoint/device security
* Data protection

You will also establish practical AI governance covering:

* which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
* permissions available to AI agents,
* human review requirements for critical decisions,
* auditability,
* and acceptable AI use.

Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.

**9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource**
================================

We do not believe everything must be built internally.

We do believe **Ergode must own the outcome.**

You will decide when to:

**BUILD** — when capability creates strategic advantage.

**BUY** — when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.

**OUTSOURCE** — when an external specialist can deliver faster.

For outsourced work, you will own:

* requirements,
* architecture,
* vendor selection,
* commercial evaluation,
* milestones,
* SLAs,
* quality,
* security,
* source code,
* documentation,
* handover.

No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 6–12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:

### **Execution**

* Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
* Delivery predictability improves materially.
* Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.

### **AI & Automation**

* Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
* Automation impact is quantified monthly.
* Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
* Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.

### **Core Platforms**

* Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
* Technical ownership and documentation improve.
* Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.

### **Data**

* Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.

### **Business Partnership**

* Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect **working solutions, not project discussions**.

**Who We Are Looking For**
==========================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* 10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
* 5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
* Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
* AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
* Practical experience with:
  + LLM APIs
  + RAG
  + AI agents / agentic workflows
  + Python
  + workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
* Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* API/integration architecture experience.
* DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
* Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
* Experience managing external technology partners.
* Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
* Strong business and commercial orientation.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

Experience in one or more of:

* E-commerce
* Marketplaces
* Retail technology
* D2C
* SaaS/platform businesses
* ERP/OMS/WMS
* Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
* High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
* AI-first enterprise transformation

**Who Will NOT Fit This Role**
==============================

This role is probably not for you if:

* Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
* Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
* Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
* You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
* You require large teams before you can execute.
* You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
* You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.

**The Person Behind the Resume**
================================

We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.

We value people who demonstrate:

**Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.**

We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.

**We are seeking an HRIS Sr. Professional to serve as the first line of HRIS support for Workday.** This role focuses on day-to-day user enablement, request triage and resolution, routine system maintenance, data quality, documentation, reporting, and testing. The position resolves routine issues independently and partners with Tier 2/3 HRIS and technical resources when a request requires deeper product expertise, complex configuration, integrations, security changes, or broader impact analysis.

Job Responsibilities:

* Serve as Tier 1 HRIS support for Workday, helping HR users and other authorized users understand how to complete transactions, locate information, and use available self-service resources.
* Triage and manage assigned Workday support requests through Jira; gather relevant details, troubleshoot issues, document work and resolution, communicate status, and route requests to the appropriate owner when escalation is required.
* Investigate routine Workday issues by reviewing user steps, data, business process status, security/access context, and available documentation; resolve issues within established scope and escalate complex or higher-risk issues to Tier 2/3 resources.
* Create, modify, and maintain simple Workday reports and support users in locating existing reports and dashboards. Escalate advanced reporting, calculated-field, matrix/composite, or broader analytics needs as appropriate.
* Perform approved low-risk/simple Workday configuration and maintenance activities in accordance with HRIS change control, testing, approval, documentation, and production-validation standards.
* Maintain HRIS job aids, knowledge articles, FAQs, and other user-enablement content; keep materials current as Workday processes and functionality change and partner with functional stakeholders for business-process nuances.
* Perform routine data-quality audits, exception reviews, reconciliations, and follow-up activities; document findings, correct or coordinate correction of issues within scope, and escalate recurring or higher-risk data concerns.
* Assist Tier 2/3 HRIS team members with functional testing, regression testing, test-script execution, defect documentation, and validation of enhancements and configuration changes.
* Participate in Workday semi-annual release readiness activities, including assigned feature review, regression testing, issue documentation, and production validation.
* Support ongoing HRIS operational work such as documentation clean-up, process follow-up, recurring administrative activities, and stabilization efforts that improve the reliability and user experience of Workday.
* Follow established HRIS governance, change-control, data-protection, documentation, and escalation standards and maintain accurate work records in Jira.
* Partner collaboratively with HR functional stakeholders, Payroll, Business Applications, and other HRIS team members to resolve requests and provide a consistent support experience.
* Identify recurring user questions, defects, data issues, or process pain points and surface opportunities for improved job aids, training, self-service, controls, or system enhancements.
* Perform other duties as required.

Qualifications:

* 2-4+ years of HRIS, HR operations, HR technology, or related systems-support experience; hands-on Workday experience strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Workday navigation and business processes; exposure to one or more functional areas such as HCM, Recruiting, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent/Performance, Learning, Help, or Reporting is preferred.
* Experience troubleshooting user or system issues and knowing when to escalate based on complexity, risk, or required system access.
* Experience creating or maintaining basic reports, user documentation, job aids, knowledge content, or training materials.
* Comfort working with data, performing recurring audits or reconciliations, and identifying discrepancies with strong attention to detail.
* Experience participating in system testing, documenting defects/results, and validating expected outcomes is preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and common productivity tools; experience with Jira or another ticket/request management platform is preferred.
* Ability to explain system steps and technical information clearly to users with different levels of Workday experience.
* Strong organization, follow-through, customer-service orientation, curiosity, and practical problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive employee information with confidentiality and professionalism and follow established access and data-governance requirements.

**The Accurate Way:**
=====================

We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.

**Take ownership.**
===================

Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.

**Be open.**
============

Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.

**Stay curious.**
=================

Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.

**Work as one.**
================

Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.

**Equal opportunities**
=======================

Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.

You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.

**Special Notice:**
===================

Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.

* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in-person format.

* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

title: Senior Learning & Development Specialist – Global
description:
**Role Overview:**  
We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Learning & Development professional to build and  
deliver practical learning programmes across our global businesses.  
You will manage the complete learning cycle—from identifying development needs and gathering  
business information to designing programmes, delivering training, administering initiatives, and  
measuring outcomes. Working closely with business leaders, HR, managers, and subject-matter  
experts, you will turn operational knowledge, business processes, and employee development needs  
into clear, relevant training.  
This role requires someone who can work independently, move quickly, and bring structure to  
evolving requirements. You should be confident in asking the right questions, securing stakeholder  
input, and converting information into learning that employees can apply in their work.  
You will also work with the AI Specialist to incorporate suitable AI tools into learning design and  
delivery, and support employees in applying these tools effectively in their roles.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
1**. Learning Strategy and Development Planning**  

* Develop and implement a Group-wide learning plan aligned with business priorities,

functional requirements, and employee development needs.  

* Identify capability gaps through discussions with leaders, managers, HR, and employees,

supported by performance information and feedback.  

* Prioritise programmes based on business impact, urgency, and available resources.
* Maintain a learning calendar that balances planned development with new processes,

operational changes, and emerging requirements.  

* Combine common Group-wide initiatives with learning tailored to individual entities,

functions, and regions.  
2. **Programme Design and Process Training**  

* Gather information from stakeholders, process documents, systems, and business updates,

and convert it into accurate, practical training.  

* Develop onboarding, role-specific learning, process and systems training, manager

development, and professional skills programmes.  

* Create presentations, facilitator guides, learning modules, assessments, process

walkthroughs, job aids, and reference materials.  

* Choose suitable formats, including workshops, live virtual sessions, self-paced learning,

coaching, and on-the-job support.  

* Validate content with subject-matter experts and maintain version control so materials

remain current as processes change.  

* Use AI tools, where appropriate, to support the development of training content,

assessments, and learning resources, with guidance from the AI Specialist.  

* Validate all training materials with relevant stakeholders to ensure accuracy, business

relevance, and appropriate handling of confidential information.  
3**. Training Delivery and Implementation**  

* Facilitate engaging sessions for employees across functions, seniority levels, entities, and

regions.  

* Manage programme rollouts, ensuring clear communication, stakeholder readiness, and

coordination across time zones.  

* Deliver targeted interventions to address specific skill gaps, operational challenges, or

business changes.  

* Support internal trainers and subject-matter experts with structured materials and delivery

guidance.  

* Reinforce learning through practical exercises, follow-up activities, and manager

involvement.  

* Use AI-supported tools and resources, where appropriate, to deliver engaging training,

support practical exercises, and reinforce learning.  

* Partner with the AI Specialist to develop practical sessions that help employees apply

approved AI tools in their day-to-day work.  
4. **Stakeholder Partnership and Employee Advisory**  

* Act as the Learning & Development point of contact for employees, managers, HR, and

business leaders across the Group.  

* Advise stakeholders on development priorities, suitable interventions, and practical learning

options.  

* Obtain the information, approvals, and participation needed to move programmes forward

without constant supervision.  

* Clarify the expected business outcome before developing training, and challenge unclear

requests constructively.  

* Distinguish learning needs from issues requiring better processes, communication, or

management action, and work with the relevant teams accordingly.  
5. **Learning Administration, Tracking and Evaluation**  

* Manage training schedules, nominations, enrolments, attendance, completion records,

assessments, and feedback.  

* Maintain organised learning resources and reliable programme records across entities and

regions.  

* Evaluate learning through assessments, employee feedback, manager input, and evidence

of application on the job.  

* Provide concise reporting on progress, participation, completion, capability gaps, and

programme outcomes.  

* Improve programmes based on results and coordinate external learning providers where

required, ensuring relevance, quality, and value.

**Essential Requirements**  

* Substantial progressive experience in Learning & Development, including independent

ownership of programme design, facilitation, implementation, administration, and  
evaluation.  

* A proven track record of building practical learning programmes, rather than only

coordinating or delivering existing training.  

* Experience supporting multiple functions or businesses, preferably within an international or

multi-entity organisation.  

* Demonstrated ability to gather information quickly and translate complex, incomplete, or

evolving inputs into clear, usable training.  

* Strong instructional design, facilitation, and content development skills.
* Openness to learning and using AI tools to support training design and delivery, with guidance

from the AI Specialist. Prior technical expertise is not required.  

* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to simplify technical and operational

information without losing accuracy.  

* Confident stakeholder management, including the ability to engage senior leaders, obtain

timely inputs, and manage competing priorities pragmatically.  

* A hands-on approach, sound judgement, and reliable follow-through in a fast-paced

environment.  

* Proficiency in Google Workspace, presentation tools, spreadsheets, and digital learning

platforms.  

* Discretion when handling confidential information and diligence when validating AI-assisted

content.  

* Availability to work full-time from the office in India, from 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST, with

occasional flexibility for global training schedules.

The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities.
* Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits.

* Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management.
* Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership
* Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare.

* Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns.
* Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms.
* Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance.
* Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose.
* Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues.
* Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues.
* Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases.
* Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption.

Operational Management

* Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues.
* Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk.
* Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation.
* Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria.

People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors.

* Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams.

Governance, Security and Risk

* Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance.

title: Looking for Personal Secretary
description:
Roles and Responsibilities are as follows -

1. Answering Calls, Taking Messages, and Handling Correspondence

Secretaries serve as the first point of contact for clients, partners, and internal teams. They manage phone lines, direct inquiries, screen calls, and ensure that communications are documented and followed up on promptly. This ensures professionalism and responsiveness in all external and internal interactions.

2. Maintaining Diaries and Arranging Appointments

Efficient time management is essential for leadership and team coordination. Secretaries manage calendars, schedule meetings, and avoid conflicts to ensure productivity. They act as gatekeepers, allowing executives to focus on strategic responsibilities without administrative overload.

3. Typing, Preparing, and Collating Reports

Whether it's drafting letters, writing proposals, or compiling performance reports, secretaries play a central role in the production of professional documents. They ensure accuracy, formatting consistency, and timely delivery of materials used in decision-making processes.

4. Filing and Documentation

Organizing physical and digital records is a critical administrative function. Secretaries maintain secure, well-structured systems that ensure quick access to important documents and compliance with information governance policies.

5. Organizing and Servicing Meetings

From scheduling and setting up meeting rooms to preparing agendas and recording minutes, secretaries are key to effective meeting management. Their detailed notes help ensure clear follow-up and accountability on action points.

6. Managing Databases

A secretary often manages databases containing client details, vendor records, or HR information. This includes regular updates, data integrity checks, and sometimes analysis, making sure that critical information is accurate and accessible when needed.

7. Prioritizing Workloads

With multiple responsibilities competing for attention, secretaries must constantly assess and adjust priorities. They juggle urgent tasks, manage time-sensitive deadlines, and support team members in optimizing their schedules.

8. Implementing New Procedures and Administrative Systems

Secretaries often identify opportunities for administrative improvements. Whether it’s transitioning to cloud-based systems, digitizing records, or streamlining workflows, they help implement smarter ways of working across departments.

9. Liaising with Relevant Organizations and Clients

Communication with external stakeholders is a key part of the role. Secretaries coordinate with vendors, clients, and partners, ensuring all interactions are professional, timely, and aligned with business goals.

10. Coordinating Mail-shots and Similar Publicity Tasks

Supporting marketing or outreach functions, some administrators assist in the distribution of newsletters, promotional materials, and public announcements. This often involves working with CRM tools or mailing platforms to maintain contact lists.

11. Logging or Processing Bills and Expenses

Financial support tasks such as tracking departmental expenses, processing payments, and managing petty cash often fall under a secretary’s remit. Their attention to detail ensures financial accuracy and proper reporting.

12. Acting as a Receptionist and Greeting Clients

In many organizations, secretaries also manage front-desk duties. They provide a warm welcome to visitors, manage guest logs, and maintain a professional office atmosphere while balancing their administrative tasks.

13. Recruiting, Supervising, and Training Junior Staff

In more senior roles, secretaries contribute to team development. This includes assisting in the hiring process, onboarding new staff, delegating tasks, and ensuring junior administrators are trained in office procedures.

14. Tracking and Ordering Office Supplies

Administrators ensure that the office is always fully equipped by managing inventory, monitoring supply usage, and negotiating with suppliers. This task helps avoid disruptions and keeps operations running smoothly.

15. Maintaining Confidentiality

Perhaps one of the most critical aspects of the role is the ability to manage sensitive information with discretion. Secretaries handle confidential reports, personnel files, and business strategies, and must ensure strict compliance with data protection policies.

16. Supporting Executive Decision-Making

Many experienced secretaries help leaders by preparing reports, gathering information, organising presentations, and ensuring executives have the materials needed for important meetings. This support improves decision-making speed and efficiency.

title: Data Modeler
description:
**About the Role**

**As a** **Data Modeler at TVH****, you will play a central role in shaping how our global organization structures, understands, and leverages its data. Operating across** **all core business domains** **(e.g., Customer, Supplier, Item, Product, Equipment, HR, Finance, Commercial, Operations, …), you will design, develop, and maintain high\-performing Logical Data Models (LDM) and Physical Data Models (PDM) that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational applications.**

**You will translate diverse cross\-domain business requirements into clear, standardized, and scalable data structures. Working closely with Domain Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Stewards, you will ensure our logical abstractions align perfectly with business reality while our physical implementations maximize database performance and data accessibility.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Logical \& Physical Data Model Design:**


	+ **Design, construct, and maintain normalized Conceptual and** **Logical Data Models (LDM)** **across all enterprise domains, establishing clear entities, attributes, relationships, and business definitions.**
	+ **Translate LDMs into optimized** **Physical Data Models (PDM)** **tailored for target database platforms, balancing storage efficiency, index strategies, and query performance.**
	+ **Reverse\-engineer legacy source systems and translate complex domain requirements into normalized, reusable data structures.**
	+ **Produce and manage comprehensive data documentation, including ERDs (Entity\-Relationship Diagrams), data dictionaries, and data mapping lineage.**
* **Domain Alignment \& Standards Governance:**


	+ **Drive consistent data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design patterns across all domain modeling initiatives.**
	+ **Partner with Data Governance teams to incorporate standardized business glossaries and enterprise metadata standards directly into model structures.**
	+ **Conduct data model reviews with technical and business teams to ensure cross\-domain consistency and avoid data duplication.**
* **Cross\-Functional Technical Collaboration:**


	+ **Work hand\-in\-hand with Domain Architects to ensure domain models fit seamlessly into TVH’s target data architecture strategy.**
	+ **Collaborate with Data Engineers to guide the physical realization of models and support optimized ETL/ELT pipeline design.**
	+ **Partner with Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Business Partners to validate logical assumptions, clarify business logic, and refine domain models as needs evolve.**
* **Model Optimization \& Quality:**


	+ **Profile source data using SQL to uncover structural edge cases and validate cardinality before finalizing logical designs.**
	+ **Refine physical schemas for cloud data warehouses, adjusting partitioning, clustering, and denormalization strategies to meet performance SLAs.**

**Qualifications**

* **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** **focused specifically on Logical Data Modeling (LDM) and Physical Data Modeling (PDM) across multiple business domains.**
* **Deep expertise in diverse modeling paradigms: Relational/Entity\-Relationship (3NF), Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake), and Denormalization concepts.**
* **Strong proficiency in** **SQL** **for deep source system profiling, data mapping, and schema validation.**
* **Hands\-on experience with modern** **cloud data warehouses** **(preferably** **GCP BigQuery****, Snowflake, or Databricks) and relational database platforms.**
* **Proficiency with enterprise data modeling tools (e.g., Erwin, PowerDesigner, SqlDBM, or similar).**
* **Solid understanding of Data Warehousing principles, metadata management, and ETL/ELT architecture.**
* **Fluent in English with excellent communication skills to articulate complex logical structures to both business stakeholders and engineering teams.**

**Preferred Skills**

* **Experience with** **Data Vault 2\.0** **modeling methodologies for enterprise scale.**
* **Exposure to real\-time or streaming data modeling patterns (Event\-driven architectures).**
* **Understanding of data privacy impact on data design (e.g., handling PII attributes across global domains).**
* **Experience working in Agile/Scrum distributed software delivery teams.**
